When a control becomes a queue in a regulated supply chain

Protect the control while testing whether the surrounding hand-offs are adding avoidable delay.

Illustrative scenario analysis · 6–8 minute read
This article illustrates a recurring supply-chain pattern and the JourneyIQ Supply Chain Diagnostic method. It does not describe a named client, completed engagement or verified customer outcome.

The situation

Teams describe every day in a regulated queue as the unavoidable cost of compliance, while nobody owns the complete journey from receipt to usable stock.

Protect the control and inspect the hand-off

Product disposition and regulatory interpretation remain with qualified people. The diagnostic stays with materials, documents, approvals and management information.

Evidence to reconstruct

Link receipt, document availability, review start, query, response, approval and release, then separate compliant processing time from preventable waiting.

Responsible recommendations

Target ownership, document timing, status visibility and supplier routines without weakening the required control.
